editorial:
Imagine your whole world being ripped away in one night. That is exactly what happens to Alex Hunter, a rising kickboxing star who loses his dad and fiancé to a cruel crime boss. After being beaten and left for dead, you get to watch him get picked up by a gritty Vietnam vet in a wheelchair. This mentor helps Alex turn his pain into power, transforming him into a masked vigilante called The Dark Angel. The vibe here is pure 90s revenge fantasy, where a broken man becomes a killing machine to take down the city's worst scum. It is a wild ride that feels like a comic book brought to life with plenty of sweat and blood.

What really works here is the action. Since Curtis Bush was a real world champion, the fights look legit and hit hard. The pacing is quick, though some of the acting can be a bit over the top. If you love old-school martial arts flicks, you will have a blast. You should definitely try to find this on a 4K Blu-ray to add to your physical collection, or see if you can rent it on Apple TV for a movie night with friends. It is the perfect kind of movie to turn your brain off and enjoy.
endingExplained: Everything leads up to the Arena of Death, where Alex has to fight his way through a lineup of deadly foreign killers. In the final showdown, Alex faces the crime boss in a brutal match. Using everything his mentor taught him, he finally defeats the villain and gets his revenge. The journalist finds out who he really is, but the movie ends with the bad guys gone and Alex finally finding some peace.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves old school kickboxing and revenge stories.
